```{r setup}
library(nfldoinkeR)
```

This dictionary was written against `format_revision` 5 of the data release.
Column types are exactly those written by the data pipeline; the package does
not re-coerce them. The released columns are the export's header as served, and
the last section of this vignette compares the tables below with the live
release so that a changed or added column shows up.

```{r revision}
info <- doink_release_info()
info$format_revision
```

If that number is not 5, the tables below may be out of date.

## Scope of the released data

Preseason games and the Hall of Fame game are excluded. Rows flagged
`is_official == FALSE` are dropped before release, so `is_official` is `TRUE`
on every released row. Rows are ordered by `game_date`, then `doink_id`.

## doinks

One row per doink.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `doink_id` | integer | Identifier of the doink record. |
| `season` | integer | Season of the game. |
| `week` | character | `"1"` to `"18"`, `"Wild Card"`, `"Divisional"`, `"Conference"` or `"Super Bowl"`. |
| `game_date` | Date | Date of the game. |
| `nflverse_game_id` | character | nflverse `game_id`. `NA` for every game before 1999 (no nflverse schedule rows exist) and for any 1999-on game not yet matched. |
| `away_team`, `home_team` | character | Away and home team of the game. |
| `away_score`, `home_score` | integer | Away and home score of the game. |
| `kicking_team` | character | Team of the kicker; key into `teams$abbreviation`. |
| `kicker_id` | integer | Key into `kickers$kicker_id`. |
| `kicker` | character | Kicker's name as recorded. |
| `play_type` | character | Type of kick: `"FG"` (field goal) or `"XP"` (extra point). |
| `distance` | integer | Distance of the kick, in yards. |
| `quarter` | character | Quarter of the kick: `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"4"` or `"OT"`. |
| `game_time` | character | Game clock reading at the time of the kick. |
| `outcome` | character | Result of the kick: `"Good"` or `"No Good"`. |
| `stadium` | character | Stadium where the game was played. |
| `gsis_id` | character | GSIS player id of the kicker; join key to `nflreadr::load_players()`. |
| `kicking_franchise` | character | Franchise of the kicking team, as released. |
| `stakes` | character | Stakes label for the kick: `"high-impact"`, `"losing"` or `"winning"`. |
| `is_official` | logical | Always `TRUE` in released data. |

## kickers

One row per kicker.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kicker_id` | integer | Identifier of the kicker; key from `doinks$kicker_id`. |
| `first_name`, `last_name` | character | Kicker's name. |
| `gsis_id` | character | GSIS player id; join key to `nflreadr::load_players()`. `NA` when the kicker has no nflverse match. |
| `gsis_status_note` | character | Note on the status of the `gsis_id`; see the allowed values below. |
| `is_position_kicker` | logical | `TRUE` for a place kicker by roster position; `FALSE` for a player filling in at kicker who is listed at another position. |

## teams

One row per team entry.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `abbreviation` | character | Team abbreviation; target of `doinks$kicking_team`. |
| `city` | character | Team city. |
| `name` | character | Team name. |
| `franchise_id` | integer | Franchise identifier. |
| `franchise` | character | Franchise name. |
| `first_year`, `last_year` | integer | First and last season for the team entry. |

## Allowed values

These are read from the current release when the vignette is built.

```{r allowed}
doinks <- load_doinks()
kickers <- load_doink_kickers()
teams <- load_doink_teams()

for (col in c("week", "quarter", "stakes", "play_type", "outcome")) {
  cat("\ndoinks$", col, "\n", sep = "")
  print(table(doinks[[col]], useNA = "ifany"))
}

cat("\nkickers$gsis_status_note\n")
print(table(kickers$gsis_status_note, useNA = "ifany"))
```

## Does this dictionary match the release?

Each element below lists columns in the live release that are missing from this
dictionary (`undocumented`), documented columns no longer in the release
(`no_longer_present`) and columns whose type differs (`type_changed`). All
three should be empty.

```{r drift}
documented <- list(
  doinks = c(
    doink_id = "integer", season = "integer", week = "character",
    game_date = "Date", nflverse_game_id = "character",
    away_team = "character", home_team = "character",
    away_score = "integer", home_score = "integer",
    kicking_team = "character", kicker_id = "integer", kicker = "character",
    play_type = "character", distance = "integer", quarter = "character",
    game_time = "character", outcome = "character", stadium = "character",
    gsis_id = "character", kicking_franchise = "character",
    stakes = "character", is_official = "logical"
  ),
  kickers = c(
    kicker_id = "integer", first_name = "character", last_name = "character",
    gsis_id = "character", gsis_status_note = "character",
    is_position_kicker = "logical"
  ),
  teams = c(
    abbreviation = "character", city = "character", name = "character",
    franchise_id = "integer", franchise = "character",
    first_year = "integer", last_year = "integer"
  )
)

column_types <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(col) class(col)[1], character(1))
}

compare_columns <- function(doc, x) {
  actual <- column_types(x)
  common <- intersect(names(doc), names(actual))
  list(
    undocumented = setdiff(names(actual), names(doc)),
    no_longer_present = setdiff(names(doc), names(actual)),
    type_changed = common[doc[common] != actual[common]]
  )
}

Map(compare_columns, documented, list(doinks = doinks, kickers = kickers, teams = teams))
```
